text:
Alex M: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Alex M: Yesterday: landed auth-fallback v2 and pushed to staging (canary 10%). Verified token refresh flows with oauth test client.
Alex M: Blocker: noticed a repeated 5-6% error rate during perf test on /v1/stream — looks like rate-limit throttles + long tails from batching.
Alex M: Today: I'm going to tune batcher window and validate prefix KV caching interactions. Will ping infra if we need extra staging capacity.

Priya K: Thanks Alex — saw the rollback alert earlier. Can you paste the exact error log?

Alex M: log snippet:
```
ERROR middleware request-id=abcd1234 path=/v1/stream status=429 reason=rate_limited tokens=1200 latency_ms=1123
WARN batcher batch_size=16 timeout_ms=50 active_batches=12
```

Samir Patel: Hmm 1123ms token latency + 429s. Could be batching queueing while some replicas are slower. Did you notice any correlate with specific model variants?

Alex M: Not yet. Looks across two variants (redwood-1-small, redwood-1-med). CPU on the med replica spiked during the test.

Jonah L: I'll check routing policy rules — maybe the traffic split pushed more p99 traffic to med. Quick check: current route has weight {small: 60, med: 40}?

Priya K: @Jonah correct — we bumped med to 40 earlier this week for quality tests. Maybe revert to 30 while Alex tunes.

Emily R: Also, FYI deploy-bot ran the canary at 03:12 UTC and flagged the 5% error rate.

deploy-bot: canary deploy redwood/auth-fallback-v2 -> 10% in staging at 2025-09-22T03:12:09Z :rocket:

Maya (oncall): If you reduce med weight, remember to update the traffic-policy in secrets (staging) or the console will reapply the old policy on next reconcile.

Alex M: Good catch Maya. I'll patch the policy in gitops then update console. PR number: 8762 (link: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/8762)

Samir Patel: Small config suggestion for rate limits — try lowering dynamic window from 1s to 250ms for the streaming endpoint, plus enable per-route prefix cache. Eg:
```
route: 
  path: /v1/stream
  rate_limit:
    requests_per_min: 6000
    dynamic_window_ms: 250
  caching:
    prefix_kv: true
```

Jonah L: That looks reasonable for staging. For prod we'll run a canary with smoke tests. Also suggest adjusting autoscale threshold for med replicas to 65% to avoid CPU spikes.

Priya K: I'll review PR 8762 and leave an approval if the revert is simple. If not we can hotfix the traffic-policy in console (manual patch).

Alex M: Thanks. I'll make the change now and kick off another perf run. Will report back here with results.

Emily R: :eyes: Ping me if you want me to run the perf harness (I can spin it up quickly).

Alex M: Appreciated — might take you up on that in ~30m.

Jonah L: One more ask — can we add a tiny smoke that asserts no 5xx/429 on basic token refresh flow for canaries? Should be quick to add to the deploy job.

Priya K: Agree. Adding a smoke gate avoids noisy rollouts. I'll open a follow-up PR after reviewing 8762.

Alex M: OK wrapping up here. Current action items: 1) Alex: modify batcher + update traffic policy PR 8762. 2) Priya: review + add smoke gate PR. 3) Jonah: check autoscale thresholds. 4) Emily: standby for perf run. 5) Samir: propose rate-limit defaults we can ship to staging tomorrow.

Alex M: Thanks team. Will update thread with perf numbers. :thumbsup:
